question: Why did only Eleazar and Ithamar serve as priests among Aaron's sons?
options: Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no sons
Nadab and Abihu moved to Egypt
Nadab and Abihu chose to be musicians
explanation: Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and they had no sons, so Eleazar and Ithamar served as the priests.
